newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's c.bank buys currency to boost liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's c.bank buys currency to boost liquidity.

text.p: Croatia's central bank said it bought German marks and dollars from the banking sector on Wednesday to boost liquidity.
It bought 115.5 million marks ($62.8 million) at an average 3.5591 kuna per mark and $6.05 million at 6.5336 kuna to the dollar, it said in a statement.
The bank will pay kuna to commercial banks on Friday.

Foreign exchange purchases are used as a primary source of money creation in Croatia, which experiences strong foreign inflow during the tourist season each summer. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385 1 4557075 ($ = 1.837 German Marks)
